name: Zero-shot cell embedding evaluation of single-cell foundation models (Kedzierska et al. 2025)
description: Zero-shot cell embeddings from scGPT (four variants) and Geneformer compared with 2,000 highly variable genes, Harmony and scVI on five human scRNA-seq datasets, scored for cell-type separation and batch mixing with scIB metrics, plus a check of each model's pretraining reconstruction objective.

attributes.version: Genome Biology 26:101 (2025)
attributes.task: Zero-shot cell embedding for cell-type clustering and batch integration
attributes.scope_note: Five datasets (Pancreas, PBMC 12k, PBMC 95k, Immune, Tabula Sapiens) plus a Pancreas (8k) row; foundation models used without training, baselines fitted on each dataset.
attributes.source_locator: Pages 3-5 'Results and discussion'; pages 7-10 'Methods'; Additional file 1

name: Geneformer (Kedzierska et al. 2025)
description: Geneformer cell representation as evaluated zero-shot by Kedzierska et al. 2025.

attributes.checkpoint: Geneformer code at commit 5d0082c (2023-11-21); 6 Transformer layers, 4 attention heads, pretrained on 27.4M human single-cell transcriptomes (Methods); cell embedding = average of gene embeddings

name: Geneformer cell embedding on evaluated datasets (Kedzierska et al. 2025)
description: Published comparison transcribed from the pinned source; not reproduced.

attributes.version: Genome Biology 26:101 and Additional file 1 as retrieved 2026-10-14

comparison.split: No split; each whole dataset embedded and scored
comparison.inputs: Each dataset's expression matrix with cell-type and batch labels; 2,000 HVG standard across experiments
comparison.adaptation: scGPT and Geneformer zero-shot from pretrained weights (scGPT random: no pretraining); scVI and Harmony fitted on each dataset with batch labels; HVG computed from each dataset
comparison.metric_implementation: scib 1.0.4. ASW of cell-type labels rescaled to [0, 1]; NMI and ARI on Louvain clusters at the resolution with the highest NMI out of 20; batch integration = 1 minus absolute batch silhouette per cell type, averaged; PCR = change in variance explained by batch between the original data and the embedding (Methods, pages 9-10).
comparison.aggregation: Across the evaluated datasets; each result states its ranking basis (Table S3: median score per metric; Tables S4 and S5: average ranking from mean scores)

attributes.source_locator: Additional file 1, sheets 'TableS3' and 'TableS4' (column 'Average ranking')

name: Kedzierska et al. 2025, Additional file 1 (Supplementary Tables S1-S7, xlsx)
description: Supplementary workbook of the article, retrieved from the publisher (Springer static content) and hashed for the 2026-10-14 genomic foundation model guide fixes.

attributes.version: Additional file 1 (13059_2025_3574_MOESM1_ESM.xlsx) of the version of record
limitations: Each model has two columns under one merged header: a single value and a value with a bracketed range. Neither column is labelled; the caption says scores were calculated on the whole dataset and in 10 repeats on 10% subsamples. Only the single-value (whole-dataset) columns are extracted.

evidence_concerns.message: The workbook numbers its tables differently from the article's Additional file 1 caption. Workbook TableS1 = dataset overview (caption S7); TableS2 = sources and pretraining overlap (caption S3); TableS3 = ranks of median scores (caption S2); TableS4 = average ranking (caption S4); TableS5 = UMAP average ranking (caption S6); TableS6 = embedding scores (caption S1); TableS7 = UMAP scores (caption S5). The in-sheet titles match the workbook sheet names. Locators use the workbook sheet names.
evidence_concerns.source_locator: Workbook sheet names and cell A1/B1 titles; article page 10, 'Supplementary information', Additional file 1 caption

evidence_concerns.message: Which of the two columns per model holds the whole-dataset score and which the 10-repeat subsample summary is not labelled; the single-value column is read as the whole-dataset score. The central statistic and the range type of the bracketed column are not stated.
evidence_concerns.source_locator: Sheets TableS6 and TableS7, row 2 merged headers C2:D2 to Q2:R2; captions in cell A1
